name: Ancient Lumocantha
body:
ANCIENT LUMOCANTHA
CR 5

XP 1,600
N Large plant
Init +5; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (–1 size, +5 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 52 (7d8+21)
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +4
Immune plant traits; Resist fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., climb 10 ft.
Melee 2 slams +7 (1d8+2 B)
Ranged laser spines +8 touch (2d6 fire, range incr. 30 ft.)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 14 (+2); Dex 20 (+5); Con 16 (+3); Int —; Wis 14 (+2); Cha 11 (+0)
Base Atk +5; CMB +8; CMD 23
Skills Climb +10, Perception +10, Survival +10; Species Modifiers +8 Perception, +8 Survival
SQ dye capsules

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dye capsules (Ex)

See above; the dye deals 2d4 acid damage and save is DC 16.

Laser Spines (Ex)

See above; as a full-round action, the ancient lumocantha can attack twice with its laser spines with a –4 penalty to each attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests
Organization solitary or colony (3–8)
Treasure special (700 gp worth of dye; Survival DC 20 to harvest)

Lumocanthas are a marvel of evolution.

Their flowers have red, fluid-filled capsules that are able to focus stored energy into concentrated laser beams. Being mindless, they do not do this out of malice but solely out of instinct, protecting themselves from creatures they perceive as threats, but allowing small animals and other plants to pass unharmed.

Lumocanthas require rich soil and large amounts of sunlight, and are able to move themselves around to pursue these needs. If their path is blocked, they use their laser blasts to clear the way forward.

Lumocantha dye is highly prized, but hunting the plants is forbidden on many worlds. Harvesting dye from a lumocantha requires a Survival check (DC 15 + the lumocantha’s CR) and yields 100 gp worth of dye per Hit Die.

Lumocanthas can live to be hundreds of years old, and continue to grow throughout their lives. Most grow to a height of about 5 feet, but the oldest can reach heights of 10 feet or more.
